40022: This policy requires a license to be issued to each client computer (device) that connects to the Remote Desktop Session Host server.
40024: This policy requires a license to be issued to each user that connects to the Remote Desktop Session Host Server. The allocation of licenses to users is not currently managed.
40026: This policy requires an AAD service plan that supports RDS license assigned to each user that connects to the Remote Desktop Session Host Server.
40028: This policy requires an External Connector license for each RDS Session Host Server that allows connections to external users.
